@documentation.@description: This is the Ref schema. It gives a specification for storage of references, branches and commits in our commit graph.

@documentation.@comment: A layer object which has the identifier used in storage.
The operation that produced a merge commit.
Merge provenance: the ordered source commits merged into a commit and the operation that produced it. Source references are literals — they may point at commits not present in this commit graph.
Branch creation provenance: the graph spec the branch was created from (a dangling literal when it names another repository) and the commit it pointed at when the branch was created.
A named branch object which points to the current head (or none if empty).

@properties.name: The name of the branch.
@properties.head: An optional commit object giving the present latest commit.
@properties.created_from: The origin the branch was created from (if one exists).

@documentation.@comment: A commit object which has the various metadata associated with a commit

@properties.author: The author of the commit.
@properties.message: The message associated with the commit.
@properties.metadata: User supplied metadata for commit as JSON.
@properties.user: The authenticated database user IRI who performed the commit.
@properties.merge_source: Merge provenance for commits produced by a merge operation (if one exists).
@properties.migration: The schema migration script (if one exists).
@properties.instance_added: Set of instance document IRIs added in this commit.
@properties.instance_updated: Set of instance document IRIs updated in this commit.
@properties.instance_removed: Set of instance document IRIs removed in this commit.
@properties.schema_added: Set of schema document IRIs added in this commit.
@properties.schema_updated: Set of schema document IRIs updated in this commit.
@properties.schema_removed: Set of schema document IRIs removed in this commit.

@documentation.@comment: A special initial commit which is replaced when data exists.
The type of commits which have passed schema validation.

@properties.author: The author of the commit.
@properties.message: The message associated with the commit.

@documentation.@comment: The type of commits which have *failed* schema validation.

@properties.author: The author of the commit.
@properties.message: The message associated with the commit.

@properties.commit: The commit object pointed to by the reference.
The commit object pointed to by the reference.
